{{Quote|Senator Seti Ashgad has disappeared, days after he protested the installation of the Senate's new cam droids. Palpatine's office says the timing is merely a coincidence.|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] report in [[21 BBY/Legends|20.6 BBY]]|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>}}
'''Senate cam droids''', also known as '''Senate hovercams''', were floating [[Cam droid/Legends|cam droids]] used in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to record sessions of Congress.

==History==
[[File:CamDroid-Republic66.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A black hovercam used by [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] to record the assassination of [[Kh'aris Fenn]].]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], these [[Cam droid/Legends|hovercams]] were used to send data to [[Director of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence|Director of Intelligence]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]].

Black-colored droids of this type were used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
